purpose: Sanitized extraction of the original TRTH processing rules from Charles Martineau's public companion fork for the earnings-news research. No credentials, local drive paths, licensed payloads, or token values are included.

raw_tas_layout.storage_shape: one exchange / year / month directory containing one or more gzipped TAS data parts per date
raw_tas_layout.data_file_filter: filename slice [15:23] == 'TAS-Data' and filename ends with .gz

checksum.behavior: skip a raw part if the calculated MD5 does not equal the first 32 characters in the sidecar

timestamp_rule.source_time: Quote Time when present; otherwise Time[G]
timestamp_rule.wrap_correction: compute Time[G] - source_time; if >23h subtract 24h; if <-23h add 24h
timestamp_rule.canonical_time: Date[G] + Time[G] - corrected_difference + GMT Offset hours

quote_extraction.original_sample_filter: keep only #RIC values in the study earnings RIC universe

timestamp_rule.source_date: Trd/Qte Date when present; otherwise Date[G]
timestamp_rule.canonical_time: source_date + Exch Time + GMT Offset hours

trade_extraction.preprocessing: drop rows with null or zero Volume before trade classification

market_hours_quality_checks.note: The original classifier records suspicious out-of-hours trades rather than silently treating them as normal-session observations.

event_window_logic.quotes: from one trading day before min(event timestamp, IBES timestamp) through two business days after max(event timestamp, IBES timestamp) in the original quote script
event_window_logic.trades: from one trading day before min(event timestamp, IBES timestamp) through one business day after max(event timestamp, IBES timestamp) in the original trade script
event_window_logic.per_event_filter: filter the staged daily file to the event security's #RIC

option_trade.timestamp: Tick History Time & Sales Date-Time for the option RIC

option_quote.timestamp: Tick History Time & Sales Date-Time for the option RIC

adaptation_notes: Do not copy original machine-specific drive letters into the production workflow.
Do not copy credentials or token-like values from any upstream LSEG sample.
The original ExtractTradesAroundEarnings.py contains a variable-reference typo (`task` inside process_event); preserve the research rule, not that implementation bug.
Actual G2 coverage remains fail-closed until licensed returned rows are validated by the existing source-contract/content validators.
